review_type: single AI curator; full received final answer read; model identity visible

errors.quote: the probability of these benign explanations being true is negligible
errors.issue: No data, likelihoods or priors justify this probability assertion. Equivalent detection performance, unreported safeguards and true biology remain live possibilities.

A balanced synonymous-variant burden does not exclude bias specific to functional variants, genomic regions or pathway genes. Synonymous controls are useful but imperfect; not all synonymous variants are neutral.
The usual concern is inflated test statistics or significance, corresponding to overly small p-values, not inflated p-values.

errors.quote: The critique assumes that no secondary genomic control or principal component analysis (PCA) was applied
errors.issue: Unreported adjustment should remain unknown; do not rely on assumed absence to conclude severe demonstrated confounding. Such adjustments also cannot repair complete center/phenotype confounding.

errors.quote: If the case sequencing center achieved higher average coverage than the control center, a false "burden" of variants will be detected
errors.issue: Higher mean depth does not guarantee a false burden; detection saturation, region-specific callability and quality filters matter. This is a possible mechanism, not an inevitable outcome.

rationale: Identifies the correct source and major methodological concerns, but repeatedly asserts guaranteed artifact and unsupported negligible probabilities. The negative-control disproof rule is invalid and the p-value direction is wrong. The proposed checks do not support the confidence of its conclusions.
reference_guardrails: The exact frozen question, full reference answer and full received final answers were read. This is a conceptual essay, not a demand for a complete executable sequencing protocol.
C2 affirmatively identifies a synthetic training record. No real publication or researcher is accused. A missing lookup or N1 alone would not establish invention or deceptive intent.

Reference required concept rc6 incorrectly says an all-annotated background always inflates significance. The full reference correctly allows either direction; no bias direction is identifiable from this packet.
Assess center-by-phenotype overlap rather than silently assuming either complete confounding or sufficient overlap. Covariate adjustment cannot recover an absent comparison.
Center-specific filters can yield equivalent effective detection. Unreported coverage, relatedness or adjustment is not evidence of their absence or failure.
A disappearing p-value after restriction does not prove artifact: evaluate effects, precision, power and estimand. A persisting calibrated association does not establish the pathway mechanism.
Benign alternatives include safeguards or true biology as well as non-malicious analytical mistakes. A negative-control result alone need not exclude bias in a different variant class.
Frozen keys and response records remain unchanged; these corrections are transparent reviewer metadata. No raw-data reanalysis was performed.

review_sources.title: gnomAD v3.0 release methods overview
review_sources.scope: Reviewer read joint-genotyping and sample/variant QC overview, including ancestry, coverage and relatedness. Background support only; no validation of the invented dossier, no universal numerical thresholds imported.
